name: relvato
description: Website monitoring your AI assistant can run: uptime and SSL, checkout and logins, security, speed, SEO with Google Search Console and Bing, visual changes, domain and DNS, and legal compliance. Add sites, run monitors, read results, review them with undo, and get the fix a run proposes.

interface.longDescription:
Relvato is a website monitoring platform. Its monitors cover uptime and SSL; user flows like sign-up, login, cart, checkout and payments; security (vulnerable plugins, signs of a hack, changed files, new admins); Core Web Vitals and real-visitor speed; visual regressions and broken links; SEO and AI search, including your Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools numbers; domain, DNS and email records; and legal compliance (cookie consent, accessibility). They run in a real browser on a schedule and again every time the site changes, on any website, going deepest on WordPress and WooCommerce.

This plugin brings your Relvato account into ChatGPT. Sign in once, then ask in plain words:
- "Which of my sites needs attention right now?"
- "How is my Google and Bing search traffic doing, and which pages are losing ground?"
- "Why did checkout fail last night, and how do I fix it?"
- "Has my WordPress site been hacked, or does it have a vulnerable plugin?"
- "How fast is my shop for real visitors, and what slows it down?"

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Set up: add a site, walk you through proving it's yours (the WordPress plugin or a DNS record), and pick monitors for your goals.
- Configure: schedules, re-runs after WordPress updates, the pages the visual monitor compares, checkout details, and custom monitors Relvato's AI writes from a plain-language goal.
- Read: health and uptime, search traffic against your usual (clicks, impressions, position, pages in the index, crawl errors), real-visitor and lab Core Web Vitals, security findings, each run's findings with screenshots, WordPress updates and the activity log.
- Act: run monitors now, get the brief for fixing a failure, and on WordPress get the one fix a run proposes or a safe update for a vulnerable plugin, applied by an administrator in WordPress; Relvato then checks the site again and tells you if anything broke.
- Review: when you confirm a change is intended, accept a new screenshot or page structure, or ignore a finding. Every such decision can be undone.

You stay in control. Tools that change your site are marked so ChatGPT asks you first. ChatGPT works within your Relvato account's limits, can't skip proving a site is yours, and can't connect Google or Bing, approve file-integrity, script or DNS changes, change who receives your alerts, see secrets, delete data or touch billing. Those stay in the Relvato dashboard.

Sign-in uses your Relvato account, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time under MCP connector → Connected assistants.
